Text: $CAT The FTC and USDA just opened a joint inquiry into anticompetitive practices across agricultural equipment (WSJ). Farmers told the USDA they face barriers buying equipment and the service to keep it running. The targets read like the Dow industrial shelf: Caterpillar off nearly 6 percent Wednesday, CNH and AGCO off more than 5, Deere down about 3. What it touches is the dealer-service line, the recurring revenue stream these companies run on. And the tape irony: CAT was the Dow's hero Tuesday, its biggest drag today.
